name: DeskBot for Kalshi
tagline: Desktop automation for Kalshi prediction markets on Mac and Windows.
description: DeskBot for Kalshi is a desktop app for Mac (Apple silicon and Intel) and Windows that runs rules-based automation for Kalshi prediction markets on your own machine. Seal subscription: $1 for the first month, then $19.99/mo, or $155/year. Trading can lose money. Not affiliated with Kalshi or Polymarket. Optional Android companion (DeskBotHQ / Multi15) for markets and status. Contact hello@deskbot.store; X @deskbotapp.
